name: Werrek Peacekeeper (CR 1/2)
body:
WERREK PEACEKEEPER
CR 1/2

This eight-foot tall humanoid has a canine face and long arms like an ape. It is covered from head to foot in shaggy brown fur and wears ill-fitting leather armor. It carries an axe with a tremendously oversized blade.

XP 200
Werrek soldier 1
LG Medium humanoid (werrek)
Init +4; Senses low-light vision; Perception +2

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 11, flat-footed 13 (+1 dodge, +3 armor)
hp 13 (1d10+2+1)
Fort +4, Ref +0, Will +3
Weakness armor aversion

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft. (40 ft. out of armor)
Melee greataxe +5 (3d6+6/×3 S; sunder, sweep) or slam +5 (1d4+6 B)
Ranged heavy crossbow +1 (2d8 P, 19-20/×2, range incr. 120 ft., AP 2)

STATISTICS

Str 19, Dex 11, Con 14, Int 14, Wis 12, Cha 10
Base Atk +1; CMB +6; CMD 17
Feats Dodge, Improved Initiative
Skills Diplomacy +3, Disable Device +2, Intimidate +6, Knowledge (engineering) +6, Perception +2, Survival +5; Racial Modifiers +2 Diplomacy, +2 Intimidate
Languages Common, Elven, Unta-Guta, Werrek
SQ fighter training, fighting style (blitz), powerful build
Gear NPC gear (studded leather armor, Large greataxe, Large heavy crossbow with 10 bolts, thieves’ tools, other gear)

ABOUT

Although werreks strike imposing figures, at heart they are a peace-loving people, who would rather negotiate than fight. Werreks love nothing more than to make new friends and share a good meal and a long conversation. When push comes to shove, though, no one shoves back as well as a werrek peacekeeper!

Galactic Legions, Vol. 2: In the Shadow of the Empire. 2026, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author. Bryan Mangum.
